开着：这个快捷键只激发本软件 —— 系统的、别的软件的同一个组合都收不到这次按键: On: the hotkey triggers only this app — the same combo no longer reaches the system or any other program (we swallow it in the low-level keyboard hook). Off: both react, as before. Combos the shell keeps for itself (Ctrl+Alt+Del, Win+L, Win+Tab) cannot be taken over, even if you record them.
